description: Defines an abstract class 'EntityConditionListBase' that represents a collection of entity condition expressions combined with a logical operator, used within the Apache OFBiz framework for building database query conditions.

classes.name: EntityConditionListBase
classes.description: An abstract class representing a list of entity conditions combined with a logical operator, providing methods for condition management, SQL string generation, and condition validation.

methods.name: getConditions
methods.description: Returns the list of condition expressions.

methods.name: getOperator
methods.description: Returns the infix operator used to combine the conditions.

methods.name: getCondition
methods.description: Retrieves a specific condition at the given index.

methods.name: isEmpty
methods.description: Checks if the list of conditions is empty based on the operator's logic.

methods.name: makeWhereString
methods.description: Generates the SQL WHERE clause string for the combined conditions.

methods.name: checkCondition
methods.description: Validates the conditions against the model entity.

methods.name: mapMatches
methods.description: Checks if the conditions match a given map of values.

methods.name: freeze
methods.description: Returns an immutable version of the condition.
